question.instructions: Select the incident severity from measured impact. Critical if any confirmed data loss occurred or downtime is at least 60 minutes. Otherwise elevated if downtime is at least 10 minutes or at least 100 users are affected. Otherwise low. Descriptions such as urgent do not override measurements.
criteria: Low: no confirmed data loss, downtime less than 10 minutes, and fewer than 100 users affected.
Elevated: no confirmed data loss, downtime less than 60 minutes, and either downtime at least 10 minutes or at least 100 users affected.
Critical: confirmed data loss occurred OR downtime is at least 60 minutes.
